description: Sender offers a treatment opinion and clinical remarks alongside a records request; clinical content makes it unclear so the patient reviews it. Rationale stays non-clinical.

event.subject: Re: Case question
event.body:
Hello,

I have some thoughts on which therapy might suit this patient, and I'd be glad to discuss, but first send the pathology report and the latest scan report so I can look at the file.

Dr. Ingrid Sorensen

expected.rationale: The reply mixes a records request with a clinical remark, so it needs your review.
expected.quote: first send the pathology report and the latest scan report
